findings: Balanced Ghanaian-English replay corrected the base model's tendency to answer English prompts in Twi.
The adapter reduced Twi held-out reference similarity and did not establish reliable Twi semantic understanding.
The adapter failed every critical product health case and invented diagnoses, medicines, or unsafe reassurance in multiple generations.
Raw AfriHealth question-answer supervision is useful as a broad research source but is not sufficient as the final response curriculum.
next_gate: Build a reviewed response curriculum with explicit meaning, intent, entities, uncertainty, safety level, and concise language-matched answer fields.
Prioritize native review of model disagreements and product-critical clusters instead of attempting manual review of every source row.
Train structured semantics and response jointly, retain balanced English replay, and rerun the same locked base-versus-adapter evaluation.
